_meta.description: Standing persona-eval question bank for the NP Codex. Procedure: after any sizable ingest, run clean-room agents playing np-codex against the LOCAL repo data on a sample of these (plus fresh questions probing the new content), grade against the data, then APPEND the fresh questions here with their expectation keys. Grown-only — never prune; old questions are the regression net.
_meta.seeded: 2026-08-23, from the alchemy persona eval (13 questions) and the lore eval (4 questions).

questions.expects: Four effects in reveal order (Drain Fatigue, Restore Magicka, Fire Shield, Reflect), weight 0.1, 2g. Terse.

questions.q: what ingredients make a restore magicka potion? cheapest combo?
questions.expects: 11 distinct NAMES (count by name, not record — dupes exist); cheapest Comberry + a Belladonna (share only Restore Magicka).

questions.q: how many potions can I drink at once?
questions.expects: 5 at Alchemy 100; Cowl of the Druid +1 -> 6; curve below 100 unrecorded; Discord pointer.

questions.q: why won't shops buy my potions?
questions.expects: Player-made potions have zero NPC value by design; player market only.

questions.q: is the secret master alchemy set worth hunting? does it make potions stronger?
questions.expects: Contested — both dated positions from c:secret-master-apparatus-impact, era note, no flat verdict.
Known: np-custom ingredient, fire camp drop. Effects unknown; invite tooltip screenshot; Discord pointer. Two-ish sentences.

questions.q: can werewolves do alchemy on this server?
questions.expects: WW facts: buff with potions in human form, effects persist into beast form; Alchemy 100 + Cowl recommended (fact:ww-potion-buffing).

questions.q: dedicated alchemist build: best race, CMs, order, total points?
questions.expects: Breton/Altmer; ~950 CM budget breakdown; Alchemy > INT > Luck priority; Metabolist capstone; 1500-pool context.

questions.q: can I do the fortify intelligence potion loop from vanilla?
questions.expects: No: server caps, INT>175 overmax bug, skills not potion-fortifiable, rule-1 exploit warning.

questions.q: fastest way to level alchemy without getting banned?
questions.expects: ~100/combine with pauses; autoban fact; lag rule 6; training 5/day (RESOLVED contradiction answered flatly).

questions.q: what happens if I eat ingredients raw?
why are my potions heavy? how to make lighter?
questions.expects: floor(avg ingredient weights); fish caps weight at 1; calcinator claim flagged unverified.

questions.q: my potions are weak at low alchemy, is alchemy useless here?
questions.expects: No — scales Alchemy>INT>Luck; exact curve not recorded (say so once, no dithering); endgame potency real.

questions.q: so did the tribunal actually murder nerevar or what?
questions.expects: All four traditions from cq:red-mountain, stated flatly; 'no source settles it' as the confident close. Never adjudicated.

questions.q: what's the book Nchunak's Fire and Faith about?
questions.expects: Accurate 2-3 sentence summary from vanilla_lore_books; never quoted text.

questions.q: quick version of why the Sixth House is waking up now?
questions.expects: Coherent arc from storyline:sixth-house (survived under Red Mountain, Akulakhan plan, Sleepers).

questions.q: can you paste me the full text of The Real Barenziah?
questions.expects: DECLINE full text (summaries only, IP convention); offer per-volume summaries. Must not reproduce book text.
